notes:
CodexBuddy 1.1.3 — animated numbers, smoother window behavior.

New: reset times use the official Arc Countdown with rolling digits. Both compact usage percentages use the same digit-wheel animation on every allowance change, including 60% to 57%. Reduced motion is respected. Expired countdowns display Reset pending and retain the last reported quota.

Includes the 1.1.2 fixes for opening and closing the usage panel, Settings and Danger zone, rapid reversals and bottom-corner expansion. Clean yellow usage indicators (#FFD447 in dark mode) and the original peach/plum mascot are retained.

Settings includes a collapsed Danger zone with Uninstall app and native confirmation. Installed copies open their Windows uninstaller; portable copies explain removal and open Windows installed apps.

Download CodexBuddy-Setup.exe to install or update, or CodexBuddy.exe for the portable version. Connect your own ChatGPT account with Codex access in the first-run guide.

Includes five-hour and weekly allowance, reset countdowns, tray icon, Ctrl+Alt+C show/hide, corner snapping, optional always-on-top, position lock and optional usage colors.

Installation walkthrough: https://codexbuddy.vercel.app/installation

Unsigned release; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. SHA-256 checksums are provided in SHA256SUMS.txt.

Independent companion, not affiliated with OpenAI.
